Get information about a DBH–height model

Source: R/hd_model_registry.R
get_hd_model_info.Rd

Returns the registry metadata for one hd_*() model variant together with its predictor table (argument, level, units, whether required, and the source's definition of the predictor).

Usage

get_hd_model_info(model_id)

Arguments

model_id

Single model identifier, as in hd_model_registry()$model_id.

Value

A named list with the registry fields of the model (list-columns unwrapped), its species coverage, and predictors, a tibble with columns arg, level, units, required, definition and source_locator.

See also

hd_model_registry(), find_hd_models()

Examples

ids <- hd_model_registry()$model_id
if (length(ids) > 0) get_hd_model_info(ids[[1]])
